name: Burpees
instructions: Start standing, then squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of you. Kick your feet back into a plank position and perform a push-up.
Jump your feet back up toward your hands, then explosively jump straight up with your arms overhead, landing softly to reset for the next rep.
Burpees combine a squat, plank, push-up, and jump into one continuous full-body movement. A 150 lb person will burn around 400 calories doing burpees for 30 minutes.
